extra.reason: Implemented complete survey recognition, safe Skip dismissal, bounded typed pty:survey fallback, retry ownership handling, Unix/Windows integration, and regression tests. Independent fmt/check/clippy and focused tests passed; two code reviews found no remaining blocking issue.

Fixed the Antigravity screen-parser false positive: the agy mode banners (accept-edits/plan/best-of-N) rendered on the empty prompt row are now recognized as placeholder text (exact-match plus wrapped-prefix match), so a ready idle prompt parses as empty instead of tui:prompt-has-text. Delivery then follows the existing inject->Enter->verify state machine and schedules exactly one turn automatically; the parser fix also restores phase-2 clear detection and submit-edge stamping after Enter. Added regression tests for the exact accept-edits banner (non-dim render, with/without ready footer), plan/best-of-N banners, wrapped narrow-pane prefix, head-only typed text staying input, banner-after-submit emptiness, update_delivery_state wiring incl. submit-edge stamping, and the gate passing on the banner-derived empty prompt. Focused tests, fmt --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, and clippy -D warnings all pass; the 6 hooks::claude full-suite failures reproduce identically at clean HEAD (pre-existing environmental).

Implemented one cursor-anchored correlated wait for exact result, typed blocker, launch failure, stopped-without-result, or deadline. Structured outcomes preserve generation/thread/cursor/evidence/recovery. Added race, resolution, generation-reuse, final-poll, payload, and CLI exit-code coverage. Focused tests, workspace check, strict Clippy, and two independent reviews passed; broad suite reached 2306 passed with two unrelated environment-dependent existing failures.

Implemented typed detection for complete Antigravity sandbox-bypass approval dialogs, preserved command evidence through shared lifecycle and result waits, verified denial/clearance, and live-tested Gemini 3.8 Flash High returning exit 4 without terminal inspection or approval input. Focused tests, cargo check, clippy, formatting, diff check, and review passed; broad suite remains at its known environment-dependent transcript PATH failure (2318 passed, 1 failed, 1 ignored).

Live verification with the freshly built f6g.12 code proved no independent bug remains. A raw Gemini 3.8 Flash High worker entered blocked/pty:approval for an outside-workspace file request; a targeted follow-up was queued while blocked; denying option 3 published pty:approval_cleared and listening; delivery then transitioned the same generation to active and the worker returned F6G13_RESUMED without direct PTY prompt injection. Focused approval falling-edge and injected-clear tests pass. The earlier failure used the pre-f6g.12 binary, which had never classified the approval.

Raw Claude and Claude PTY launches now default to --permission-mode auto unless config or CLI supplies an explicit mode. Focused argument tests, workspace check, help/docs, and a live raw hcom claude bd show run passed without approval.

Kept the Unix survey poll cap active while blocker clearing remains pending; added bounded retry cooldowns and 30-second warning rate limits for deferred publication and failed clearing. Focused PTY tests, workspace check, strict Clippy, and review pass.

Deterministic stale-snapshot race test, fail-closed tests, pty dominance + falling-edge tests; full serial suite 2451/2451 + cli_smoke 60/60.

PTY refusal mirrors actual row state and DB failures are logged. Regression coverage includes parallel Reads, stale snapshots, replacement approvals, missing tool IDs, PTY races, legacy coexistence, and DB error handling.
